findings.title: Non-EQL releases now reach the lock refresh and skew-gated asset steps that they previously never ran
findings.label: trivial
findings.note: It is true that steps 3-4 now run on non-EQL releases, but that is the PR's intent: prepareBindingAssets skips when there is no skew, and by the finding's own account the worst case (a loud failure) is no worse than the base, which failed every such release.
